title: Engine NE Speed Sensor Error
detail_of_failure: Errors occur in the signals from the engine Ne speed sensor.
controller_action: Continues control with signals of the engine Bkup speed sensor.
machine_effect: • Engine hunts. • Engine startability is unsatisfactory. • Engine output is reduced.
related_information: • The inside of the speed sensor consists of a hall sensor and electronic circuit instead of a coil. So you cannot judge whether the sensor is correct or not by measurement of the resistance of the speed sensor with a multimeter. • When correct, 5V pulses are output from the speed sensor. They cannot be measured with a multimeter. • The speed sensor senses the passes of the speed sensing wheel oblong hole installed to inside of the crankshaft vibration damper rotated with the crankshaft. • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Start the engine.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.

steps.cause: Defective Ne speed sensor power supply system
steps.procedure: If failure code [CA238] is also shown at the same time, do the troubleshooting for that code first.

steps.cause: Damaged engine Ne speed sensor or defective installation (looseness)
steps.procedure: Do checks because the engine Ne speed sensor installation can be defective (loosened).

steps.cause: Defective Ne speed sensor power supply input
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector CRANK SENSOR, and connect a T-adapter to the female side. 3. Starting switch: ON

measurements.point: Between CRANK SEN- SOR (female) (1) and (2) / Power input

steps.cause: Open circuit in wiring harness (wire breakage or defective contact of connector)
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and CRANK SENSOR.

measurements.point: If no failure is found by check on cause 4, this check is not required. Between ECM (female) (16) and CRANK SENSOR (female) (1)
If no failure is found by check on cause 4, this check is not required. Between ECM (female) (48) and CRANK SENSOR (female) (2)

steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and CRANK SENSOR.

measurements.point: Between ECM (female) (16) and (27), or between CRANK SENSOR (female) (1) and (3)
Between ECM (female) (27) and (48), or between CRANK SENSOR (female) (2) and (3)

steps.cause: Ground fault in wiring harness (contact with ground circuit)
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and CRANK SENSOR.

measurements.point: Between ground and ECM (female) (27) or CRANK SENSOR (female) (3)

steps.cause: Hot short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector CRANK SENSOR. 3. Starting switch: ON

steps.cause: Breakage and looseness of speed sensing wheel

steps.procedure: If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine Ne speed sensor is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
